name: Ziggi's Landscaping
title: Ziggi's Landscaping | Landscaping & lawn care in Tampa, FL
description: Ziggi's Landscaping designs, installs and maintains yards for homes and businesses across Tampa Bay. One owner-led team handles it from the first sketch to the final walk-through. 4.9 on Google from 241 reviews.
heroAlt: Modern white home with fresh lawn and landscaped front beds
headline:
Landscapes built right.
Kept that way.
intro: Ziggi's Landscaping designs, installs and maintains yards for homes and businesses across Tampa Bay, from the first sketch to the finished yard.

highlights.title: Why Tampa neighbors call Ziggi's
highlights.intro: Design, installation, irrigation, lighting and upkeep from one company.

points.name: Owner-led
points.text: Justin, a teacher turned landscape pro, leads the work. Reviews thank him and his team by name.

points.name: Full service
points.text: Design, turf, irrigation, lighting and maintenance, so one company knows your yard.

points.name: Built for Florida
points.text: Plants, irrigation and turf are chosen for Tampa Bay's climate, soil and seasons.

points.name: Homes and businesses
points.text: Residential yards get the same attention as commercial properties, start to finish.

servicesTitle: Everything your yard needs, from one team.
servicesIntro: A full makeover or steady upkeep, for homes and businesses.

services.name: Landscape Design & Installation
services.text: Custom layouts and quality craftsmanship, from concept to finished yard.

services.name: Irrigation Systems
services.text: Efficient, smart irrigation that keeps lawn and garden healthy while saving water and time.

services.name: Outdoor Lighting
services.text: Low-voltage lighting for pathways, gardens and architectural highlights.

services.name: Lawn & Landscape Maintenance
services.text: Scheduled mowing, edging, trimming and general upkeep all year.

services.name: Turf Installation
services.text: Real sod or artificial turf, installed for families, pets and low-maintenance living.

services.name: Planting & Bed Design
services.text: Plants, flower beds and shrubs chosen and arranged for Florida's environment.

promise: We don't just mow. We take care of it. Every edge, every bed, every visit.

why.name: Owner-led
why.text: Justin moved Ziggi's to Tampa in 2021 and leads the work himself, with his team.

why.name: One company, full service
why.text: Design, installation, irrigation, lighting and maintenance in one place.

why.name: Tailored designs
why.text: Designs that reflect you and your property, not a template.

howTitle: From first call to finished yard.

steps.name: Tell us your plan
steps.text: Call or send the form with your project, timeline and budget.

steps.name: Get a plan
steps.text: We assess the property and share a design for your approval.

steps.name: We build it
steps.text: Our crew installs it and walks it through with you at the end.

reviews.text: Justin really listened to what I wanted and provided a complete landscape plan for approval to make sure we were on the same page. The yard turned out amazing! Thanks to Justin and his team!
reviews.name: Kari

reviews.text: Ziggi's was able to talk us through the various sod options and what made the most sense given our sunlight/neighbors lawns, etc. They were incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. Their work was done quickly and neatly.
reviews.name: Lindsay Maloney

reviews.text: Our office needed a major refresh after 20 years of the same plants being in place. Ziggi's came and assessed the property, gave us great visuals and fair pricing, and did a spectacular job. Our office looks fantastic now.
reviews.name: Dennis Regan

reviews.text: The fresh sod completely transformed my backyard into a lush, green, and inviting space.
reviews.name: Shannon Webley

reviews.text: They helped transform our front and backyard into an area that we can actually enjoy, and we are so thankful!
reviews.name: Morgan Laurienzo

reviews.text: We wanted a fresh restart to the front yard and they delivered. His team worked fast, helped with recommendations and incorporated what we wanted as well.
reviews.name: Scott Brown
